river_name: No river bank but it has a Lakshmi Pushkarini (Temple Tank)

ghats.name: Lakshmi Pushkarini Bathing Ghat
ghats.description: Clean foothill temple tank with dedicated stone steps, shower units, and changing rooms for women.

significance: Devotees take a sacred holy bath in Lakshmi Pushkarini before ascending the hill to enter the Swayambhu cave sanctum.
safety_rules: Always stay within fenced safe bathing enclosures. Follow temple guard safety guidelines.
